mapper.insert: INSERT INTO topic_tags (topic_id, tag_id, created_at) VALUES (#{topicId}, #{tagId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (topic_id, tag_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT tag_id FROM topic_tags WHERE topic_id = #{topicId}

SELECT t.id, t.code, t.name, t.slug, t.created_at, t.created_by, t.updated_at, t.updated_by, t.deleted_at, t.deleted_by FROM tags t INNER JOIN topic_tags tt ON t.id = tt.tag_id WHERE tt.topic_id = #{topicId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
